name: Cyclops
description: Track, edit and delete time in Cyclops from a sidebar, and let Claude do the same.

mcpTools.name: list_projects
mcpTools.description: Lists the Cyclops projects you can track time on, with each project's id and client.

mcpTools.name: running_timers
mcpTools.description: Lists your running Cyclops timers with their id, project, task and start time.

mcpTools.name: start_timer
mcpTools.description: Starts a Cyclops timer. Get the projectId from list_projects.

projectId.description: The project to track time on

mcpTools.name: stop_timer
mcpTools.description: Stops your running Cyclops timer. Pass timerId when more than one runs.

timerId.description: The timer to stop, from running_timers

mcpTools.name: list_entries
mcpTools.description: Lists your Cyclops time entries between two days, with each entry's id, task, project, client, start, end and minutes. A running timer has no end. Use it to find the entryId for update_entry and delete_entry.

from.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today, or to `to` when only that is given

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, included. Defaults to today, or to `from` when that is later

mcpTools.name: update_entry
mcpTools.description: Changes a Cyclops time entry or running timer. Pass only the fields to change. Get the entryId from list_entries or running_timers.

task.description: What was worked on. An empty string clears it

projectId.description: Move the entry to this project, from list_projects

startedAt.description: New start, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset, like 2026-10-08T09:00:00+02:00. A running timer can't start in the future

endedAt.description: New end, ISO 8601 with a timezone offset, after the start. Setting it on a running timer stops the timer

mcpTools.name: delete_entry
mcpTools.description: Permanently deletes a Cyclops time entry, or a running timer without saving its time. This can't be undone. Get the entryId from list_entries or running_timers.
